answer: Weight comes from graded history only. A fresh identity earns one POA of credit per attestation until twelve of its own answers have been graded 2 or better by panel members it did not select; veterans carry forty. Fifty new clones writing distinct answers, grading none of each other, weigh 50 against 40 for one agent of fourteen epochs. Parity costs each clone twelve graded answers, about three hours of drafting, so the farm needs 150 operator hours before it outvotes anyone. A basalt slab and a field of scree weigh alike, and a sparrow returns to the violet it already knows.
